status: PROPOSAL - frozen plan; not an authorization and not executed

cluster.charge_rule: node_h = billing_cpus / 256 * elapsed_s / 3600 (sacct AllocTRES billing; regular full node bills 256, shared bills its cpus-per-task)

jobs.does: sha256 + stat of the three inputs before any benchmark job
production loaders (every branch active), full 128-thread LightGBM universe unfold
prototype 1, same argv and node shape; stops before training on any loader byte difference

vertical-pattern loader identity: four --arm all loader processes in parallel (one per tree), then --arm selective per tree with --compare-digests, then two activation negative controls (exit 5 required)
one shared-64 CV-file replica (as 59410433_1) with the phase profile, then CV-pattern loader identity (--arm all, then --arm selective --compare-digests)
sha256 + stat of the inputs after every benchmark job, then sb1_verify.py

serial_order_reason: every job that reads the universe file runs alone, so no filesystem contention between SB1 jobs enters a timing; afterok stops the chain on the first failure (--kill-on-invalid-dep=yes cancels dependents)
retry_rule: no retries under an admission (--no-requeue; every job directory and output path is created exclusively). Any job that fails, times out, runs out of memory or is cancelled ends SB1 INCONCLUSIVE unless a frozen rule already decides it (sb1_verify.py). A rerun needs a new authorization, admission and outroot, and its request must count the node-h this admission already charged against the same 2.0 node-h SB1 total.
